SELECT X.CODCFO || ' ' || COALESCE(C.NOME, '') AS CLIENTE_FORNEC,
       X.NUMEROMOV AS DOCUMENTO, X.SERIE, X.DATAEMISSAO, X.CODVEN1 AS VEND,
       X.VALORBRUTO, COALESCE(X.VALORDESC, 0) + X.DESC_ITENS AS DESCONTO, X.VALORDESP AS DESPESA, X.VALORLIQUIDO,
       X.VALORLIQUIDO * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(X.VALORLIQUIDO) OVER (), 0) AS PERC,
       CASE WHEN P.AVISTA = 'T' THEN 'V' ELSE 'P' END AS AVISTA,
       CASE X.SIT WHEN 'C' THEN 'Cancelada' ELSE 'Autorizada' END AS SITUACAO,
       X.CODTMV, X.CODFILIAL || '-' || COALESCE(F.NOME, F.NOMEFANTASIA, '') AS FILIAL,
       COALESCE(F.NOMEFANTASIA, F.NOME, '') AS EMPRESA,
       MIN(X.CODFILIAL) OVER () AS FILIAL_DE, MAX(X.CODFILIAL) OVER () AS FILIAL_ATE,
       CAST(:DATA_EMISSAO_DE AS DATE) AS PERIODO_INI, CAST(:DATA_EMISSAO_ATE AS DATE) AS PERIODO_FIM,
       X.IDMOV
FROM (
  SELECT M.IDMOV, M.CODEMPRESA, M.CODCFO, M.NUMEROMOV, M.SERIE, M.DATAEMISSAO, M.CODVEN1, M.CODTMV,
         M.CODCPG, M.CODFILIAL, M.VALORBRUTO, M.VALORDESC, M.VALORDESP, M.VALORLIQUIDO,
         COALESCE((SELECT SUM(I.VALORDESC) FROM TMOVITENS I WHERE I.IDMOV = M.IDMOV AND I.CODEMPRESA = M.CODEMPRESA), 0) AS DESC_ITENS,
         CASE WHEN M.STATUS = 'C'
                OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TMOVNFE N WHERE N.IDMOV = M.IDMOV AND N.CODEMPRESA = M.CODEMPRESA AND N.STATUSNFE = 2)
                OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TMOVNFSE S WHERE S.IDMOV = M.IDMOV AND S.STATUSNFSE = 3)
              THEN 'C' ELSE 'A' END AS SIT
  FROM TMOV M
  WHERE M.CODTMV STARTING WITH '2'
    AND (CAST(:DATA_EMISSAO_DE AS DATE) IS NULL OR M.DATAEMISSAO >= CAST(:DATA_EMISSAO_DE AS DATE))
    AND (CAST(:DATA_EMISSAO_ATE AS DATE) IS NULL OR M.DATAEMISSAO <= CAST(:DATA_EMISSAO_ATE AS DATE))
    AND (CAST(:CODIGO_TIPO_MOVIMENTO AS VARCHAR(2000)) IS NULL OR POSITION(',' || TRIM(M.CODTMV) || ',' IN ',' || REPLACE(CAST(:CODIGO_TIPO_MOVIMENTO AS VARCHAR(2000)), ' ', '') || ',') > 0)
    AND (CAST(:FILIAL AS INTEGER) IS NULL OR M.CODFILIAL = CAST(:FILIAL AS INTEGER))
) X
LEFT JOIN FCFO C ON C.CODCFO = X.CODCFO AND C.CODEMPRESA = X.CODEMPRESA
LEFT JOIN TCONDPGTO P ON P.CODCONDPGTO = X.CODCPG AND P.CODEMPRESA = X.CODEMPRESA
LEFT JOIN GFILIAL F ON F.CODFILIAL = X.CODFILIAL AND F.CODEMPRESA = X.CODEMPRESA
WHERE (COALESCE(CAST(:SITUACAO AS VARCHAR(20)), 'AMBAS') = 'AMBAS'
       OR X.SIT = SUBSTRING(CAST(:SITUACAO AS VARCHAR(20)) FROM 1 FOR 1))
ORDER BY X.DATAEMISSAO, X.NUMEROMOV

SELECT Y.GRUPO, Y.CST, Y.CFOP, Y.CST || ' - ' || Y.NATUREZA AS DESCRICAO,
       Y.VALOR_CONTABIL, Y.BASE_CALCULO, Y.IMPOSTO_CREDITO, Y.ISENTAS_NAO_TRIB,
       MAXVALUE(Y.VALOR_CONTABIL - Y.BASE_CALCULO - Y.ISENTAS_NAO_TRIB, 0) AS OUTRAS
FROM (
SELECT X.GRUPO, X.CST, X.CFOP, X.NATUREZA,
       SUM(X.VALOR) AS VALOR_CONTABIL, SUM(X.BASE) AS BASE_CALCULO, SUM(X.ICMS) AS IMPOSTO_CREDITO,
       SUM(CASE WHEN X.ISENTO = 1 AND X.ICMS = 0 THEN X.VALOR ELSE 0 END) AS ISENTAS_NAO_TRIB
FROM (
  SELECT TRIM(COALESCE(I.CST, '')) AS CST,
         REPLACE(SUBSTRING(COALESCE(I.CODNAT, M.CODNAT) FROM 1 FOR 5), '.', '') AS CFOP,
         COALESCE(N.NOME, '') AS NATUREZA,
         CASE SUBSTRING(COALESCE(I.CODNAT, M.CODNAT) FROM 1 FOR 1) WHEN '1' THEN '1.0 - DO ESTADO'
              WHEN '2' THEN '2.0 - DE OUTROS ESTADOS' ELSE '3.0 - DO EXTERIOR' END AS GRUPO,
         CAST(COALESCE(I.VALORTOTALITEM, 0) + COALESCE(I.VALORFRETE, 0) + COALESCE(I.VALORDESP, 0)
           + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(T2.VALOR) FROM TTRBMOV T2 WHERE T2.IDMOV = I.IDMOV AND T2.NSEQITMMOV = I.NSEQ
                        AND T2.CODEMPRESA = I.CODEMPRESA AND T2.CODTRB IN ('IPI', 'ICMSST')), 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS VALOR,
         CAST(CASE WHEN COALESCE(N.CREDITOICMS, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(T.BASEDECALCULO, 0) ELSE 0 END AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS BASE,
         CAST(CASE WHEN COALESCE(N.CREDITOICMS, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(T.VALOR, 0) ELSE 0 END AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS ICMS,
         CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(TRIM(COALESCE(I.CST, '')) FROM 2 FOR 2) IN ('30', '40', '41') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ISENTO
  FROM TMOVITENS I
  JOIN TMOV M ON M.IDMOV = I.IDMOV AND M.CODEMPRESA = I.CODEMPRESA
  LEFT JOIN TNATUREZA N ON N.CODNAT = COALESCE(I.CODNAT, M.CODNAT) AND N.CODEMPRESA = I.CODEMPRESA
  LEFT JOIN TTRBMOV T ON T.IDMOV = I.IDMOV AND T.NSEQITMMOV = I.NSEQ AND T.CODEMPRESA = I.CODEMPRESA AND T.CODTRB = 'ICMS'
  WHERE M.CODNAT IS NOT NULL
    AND (M.STATUS IS NULL OR M.STATUS <> 'C')
    AND M.DATAEMISSAO BETWEEN CAST(:DATA_INICIAL AS DATE) AND CAST(:DATA_FINAL AS DATE)
    AND SUBSTRING(COALESCE(I.CODNAT, M.CODNAT) FROM 1 FOR 1) IN ('1','2','3')
    AND (CAST(:FILIAL AS INTEGER) IS NULL OR M.CODFILIAL = CAST(:FILIAL AS INTEGER))
) X
GROUP BY X.GRUPO, X.CST, X.CFOP, X.NATUREZA
) Y
ORDER BY Y.GRUPO, Y.CST, Y.CFOP

SELECT Y.GRUPO, Y.CST, Y.CFOP, Y.CST || ' - ' || Y.NATUREZA AS DESCRICAO,
       Y.VALOR_CONTABIL, Y.BASE_CALCULO, Y.IMPOSTO_DEBITO, Y.ISENTAS_NAO_TRIB,
       MAXVALUE(Y.VALOR_CONTABIL - Y.BASE_CALCULO - Y.ISENTAS_NAO_TRIB, 0) AS OUTRAS
FROM (
SELECT X.GRUPO, X.CST, X.CFOP, X.NATUREZA,
       SUM(X.VALOR) AS VALOR_CONTABIL, SUM(X.BASE) AS BASE_CALCULO, SUM(X.ICMS) AS IMPOSTO_DEBITO,
       SUM(CASE WHEN X.ISENTO = 1 AND X.ICMS = 0 THEN X.VALOR ELSE 0 END) AS ISENTAS_NAO_TRIB
FROM (
  SELECT TRIM(COALESCE(I.CST, '')) AS CST,
         REPLACE(SUBSTRING(COALESCE(I.CODNAT, M.CODNAT) FROM 1 FOR 5), '.', '') AS CFOP,
         COALESCE(N.NOME, '') AS NATUREZA,
         CASE SUBSTRING(COALESCE(I.CODNAT, M.CODNAT) FROM 1 FOR 1) WHEN '5' THEN '5.0 - PARA O ESTADO'
              WHEN '6' THEN '6.0 - PARA OUTROS ESTADOS' ELSE '7.0 - PARA O EXTERIOR' END AS GRUPO,
         CAST(COALESCE(I.VALORTOTALITEM, 0) + COALESCE(I.VALORFRETE, 0) + COALESCE(I.VALORDESP, 0)
           + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(T2.VALOR) FROM TTRBMOV T2 WHERE T2.IDMOV = I.IDMOV AND T2.NSEQITMMOV = I.NSEQ
                        AND T2.CODEMPRESA = I.CODEMPRESA AND T2.CODTRB IN ('IPI', 'ICMSST')), 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS VALOR,
         CAST(CASE WHEN 1 = 1 THEN COALESCE(T.BASEDECALCULO, 0) ELSE 0 END AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS BASE,
         CAST(CASE WHEN 1 = 1 THEN COALESCE(T.VALOR, 0) ELSE 0 END AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS ICMS,
         CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(TRIM(COALESCE(I.CST, '')) FROM 2 FOR 2) IN ('30', '40', '41') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ISENTO
  FROM TMOVITENS I
  JOIN TMOV M ON M.IDMOV = I.IDMOV AND M.CODEMPRESA = I.CODEMPRESA
  LEFT JOIN TNATUREZA N ON N.CODNAT = COALESCE(I.CODNAT, M.CODNAT) AND N.CODEMPRESA = I.CODEMPRESA
  LEFT JOIN TTRBMOV T ON T.IDMOV = I.IDMOV AND T.NSEQITMMOV = I.NSEQ AND T.CODEMPRESA = I.CODEMPRESA AND T.CODTRB = 'ICMS'
  WHERE M.CODNAT IS NOT NULL
    AND (M.STATUS IS NULL OR M.STATUS <> 'C')
    AND M.DATAEMISSAO BETWEEN CAST(:DATA_INICIAL AS DATE) AND CAST(:DATA_FINAL AS DATE)
    AND SUBSTRING(COALESCE(I.CODNAT, M.CODNAT) FROM 1 FOR 1) IN ('5','6','7')
    AND (CAST(:FILIAL AS INTEGER) IS NULL OR M.CODFILIAL = CAST(:FILIAL AS INTEGER))
) X
GROUP BY X.GRUPO, X.CST, X.CFOP, X.NATUREZA
) Y
ORDER BY Y.GRUPO, Y.CST, Y.CFOP

SELECT D.DEBITOS, C.CREDITOS, D.DEBITOS - C.CREDITOS AS SALDO_DEVEDOR,
       CAST(:DATA_INICIAL AS DATE) AS PERIODO_INI, CAST(:DATA_FINAL AS DATE) AS PERIODO_FIM

         CAST(CASE WHEN 1 = 1 THEN COALESCE(T.BASEDECALCULO, 0) ELSE 0 END AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS BASE,

         CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(TRIM(COALESCE(I.CST, '')) FROM 2 FOR 2) IN ('30', '40', '41') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ISENTO
  FROM TMOVITENS I
  JOIN TMOV M ON M.IDMOV = I.IDMOV AND M.CODEMPRESA = I.CODEMPRESA
  LEFT JOIN TNATUREZA N ON N.CODNAT = COALESCE(I.CODNAT, M.CODNAT) AND N.CODEMPRESA = I.CODEMPRESA
  LEFT JOIN TTRBMOV T ON T.IDMOV = I.IDMOV AND T.NSEQITMMOV = I.NSEQ AND T.CODEMPRESA = I.CODEMPRESA AND T.CODTRB = 'ICMS'
  WHERE M.CODNAT IS NOT NULL
    AND (M.STATUS IS NULL OR M.STATUS <> 'C')
    AND M.DATAEMISSAO BETWEEN CAST(:DATA_INICIAL AS DATE) AND CAST(:DATA_FINAL AS DATE)
    AND SUBSTRING(COALESCE(I.CODNAT, M.CODNAT) FROM 1 FOR 1) IN ('5','6','7')
    AND (CAST(:FILIAL AS INTEGER) IS NULL OR M.CODFILIAL = CAST(:FILIAL AS INTEGER))
) S) D
CROSS JOIN (SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(E.ICMS), 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS CREDITOS FROM (
